source.title: Open problems in the discretization of Volterra integral equations

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/1062165 for document identifier 1062165. Local workflow shard metadata matches the same resolver record and DOI 10.1080/01630569608816721; exact-work search results identify the work as 'Open problems in the discretization of Volterra integral equations' by H. Brunner (1996).

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus network_or_dns_failure. Direct shell fetches to zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed DNS resolution in the restricted environment. Browser access to the zbMATH public page and API exposed a blocked page or terms gate and no readable full-text artifact.

Identifier-specific and bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, DOI, and title. Searches for the exact DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus first author, and publisher DOI/PDF paths surfaced only citations, references in other papers, related Volterra survey works, or inaccessible publisher/resolver pages. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, local shard metadata, DOI metadata, citation pages, search snippets, references in other papers, or related works.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-1062165.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
